questions.question: Do you use headphones?
ideas: Mention how frequently you use them
Explain what you use them for
collocations: listen to music on the go
sample_answers: Yes, I use headphones almost every day. I mainly use them when I'm studying or travelling because they help me concentrate and block out background noise.
Definitely. I usually use wireless headphones when I'm working, exercising, or watching videos. They're convenient because I don't have to deal with tangled cables.
Yes, quite often. I find headphones particularly useful when I need some privacy or want to focus on something without being distracted by my surroundings.

questions.question: What type of headphones do you use?
sample_answers: I mostly use wireless earbuds because they're small and convenient. I can easily carry them around and use them whenever I need them.
I prefer over-ear headphones with noise cancellation. They're particularly useful when I'm studying because they help me block out distractions.
I use fairly simple wireless headphones. I don't need anything extremely expensive; comfort and decent sound quality are more important to me.

questions.question: When did you start using social media?
ideas: Mention your age or school period
Mention how your usage has changed
sample_answers: I started using social media when I was in secondary school. At first, I mainly used it to keep in touch with my classmates, but these days I use it more for entertainment and learning.
I think I was around thirteen when I first joined a social media platform. Back then, I was mostly interested in seeing what my friends were doing.
I started using social media quite young. My main reason was to communicate with friends, although nowadays I also use it to follow educational content.

questions.question: Do you think you spend too much time on social media?
collocations: take a break from social media
sample_answers: Sometimes, yes. I can easily spend more time than I intended scrolling through videos, so I try to set limits when I have important work to do.
Probably a little too much. Social media is useful for staying connected, but it's incredibly easy to lose track of time when you're constantly scrolling.
I wouldn't say I spend excessive amounts of time on it, but there are definitely days when I use it more than I should, especially when I'm bored.

sources: IELTS Speaking Lab – May-August 2026 Social Media

questions.question: Do you remember your teachers from primary school?
sample_answers: Yes, I remember several of them, especially my English teacher. She was incredibly patient and always encouraged us to express our ideas instead of simply memorizing information.
I remember some of my primary school teachers quite clearly. One of them was particularly kind and supportive, which made me feel much more confident in class.
Yes, especially the teachers who were genuinely enthusiastic about their subjects. Their enthusiasm made lessons much more interesting and memorable.

questions.question: Do you wear a watch?
sample_answers: Not very often. I usually check the time on my phone, so I don't really need a watch, although I sometimes wear one on formal occasions.
Yes, I wear a watch almost every day. Apart from being practical, I think it can also be a nice accessory.
Occasionally. I used to wear one more frequently, but smartphones have made it less necessary for me.

questions.question: Do you like science?
sample_answers: Yes, particularly when science is connected to real-life problems. I find it fascinating to understand how things work and how scientific discoveries can improve people's lives.
I do, although I prefer some branches of science to others. I've always found technology and computer science particularly interesting.
Yes, I think science is fascinating. Even though I don't study it formally, I enjoy learning about new discoveries and technological developments.

questions.question: Do you like going to parks?
sample_answers: Yes, I really enjoy going to parks, especially when I need a break from studying or working. It's a good way to get some fresh air and clear my mind.
Definitely. I like walking around parks because they're usually peaceful and give me a chance to spend some time outdoors.
Yes, although I don't visit them every day. I particularly enjoy going to a nearby park in the evening when the weather is pleasant.
